This claim, made for all four lines, is inaccurate. The lines do not reach 0.8% by 2020. For example, the dotted purple line is at approximately 1.3% in 2019 and 0.8% in 2021; its value in 2020 would be somewhere in between, but not 0.8%.

The description incorrectly claims that three of the four lines remain stable until 2019 after their peak. In reality, all lines show a clear and steady decline from their peak around 2013/2014 to the year 2019.

The solid blue line (Herbst 2024) ends at a value of approximately 0.35% in 2029, not 0.3%.
